title: Run one bounded Form-4 falsification kill test
goal: Preregister and execute exactly one low-cost historical kill test of the simple public Form-4 open-market-purchase hypothesis. Stop with no-go when lawful free data, publication-time execution, realistic costs, independent-event counting or fixed baselines remove the effect. Do not build a general research platform, prospective collector, broker integration or model-search system.

approval.note: Only the bounded research kill test is authorised. Paid data, scheduled prospective collection, broker/wallet access, orders, leverage and capital deployment remain excluded.

acceptance.assertion: Before any return outcome is read, one canonical digest freezes the signal, eligible universe, data-availability period rule, next-trading-day-close entry, 20-trading-day close exit, issuer-level independence rule, 50-basis-point round-trip cost, doubled-cost stress and exclusions. No parameter search or best-result selection is permitted.

Only positively reviewed free sources may be ingested. Unknown terms, paid access, incomplete publication timestamps, missing delistings or fewer than 200 independent eligible events produce immediate no-go without further infrastructure work.
The primary trade clock starts from the public filing acceptance time, never the insider transaction date. Entry is the next eligible trading-day close and the same rule is used for every event.
At most one signal per issuer enters each 20-trading-day holding window. Overlapping issuer events are aggregated or rejected and are never counted as independent observations.

The untouched final time segment is compared with fixed eligible-universe, simple momentum and matched-random baselines. Results include doubled costs, removal of the ten best trades, year or regime slices and the declared liquidity exclusion without changing rules after outcomes.

The result is no-go when the effect fails after public-release timing, one-day-delay execution, realistic costs, top-ten removal, minimum sample size or baseline comparison, or when a few illiquid securities dominate it.

Completion publishes the preregistration digest, reproducibility manifest, full positive or negative result and exactly one outcome: no-go or independent-review-request. Neither outcome authorises prospective infrastructure, paper trading or real capital.

scope_revision.reason: The former multi-stage research and six-month shadow plan had excessive data, time and capital opportunity cost relative to direct paid work.
scope_revision.supersedes: broad out-of-sample programme and automatic prospective-shadow progression

acceptance_evidence.single-hypothesis-preregistered: The merged evidence freezes one Form-4 hypothesis and deterministic preregistration digest before outcome readback; no parameter search or best-result selection was introduced.
acceptance_evidence.lawful-free-data-gate: The experiment stopped with no-go when reproducible lawful/free issuer and insider-filing coverage did not satisfy the preregistered data gate; paid or broker access was not added.
acceptance_evidence.publication-time-primary-test: The preregistered clock remains public filing acceptance time with next-eligible-close entry; the data gate stopped execution before return computation rather than relaxing the rule.
acceptance_evidence.independent-event-accounting: Issuer-level non-overlap accounting remains frozen in the preregistration and was not weakened after the data gate failed.
acceptance_evidence.fixed-baselines-and-stresses: Fixed baselines and stress tests remain frozen; no outcome-driven adaptation occurred because the kill test terminated before return analysis.
acceptance_evidence.automatic-kill-criteria: The declared lawful/free reproducibility and sample-availability kill gate triggered a terminal no-go before follow-on infrastructure or trading work.
acceptance_evidence.bounded-terminal-output: PR #2 publishes the preregistration, reproducibility manifest and terminal no-go; exact head passed both required Python jobs and merged to the commit that equals current alpha-lab main.

does_not_establish: future correctness after later repository changes
